classification: exact progressive lookup representation of a compiled synthetic Q table

controls.scope_warning: The policy control answers less, while the strong lossless control is not independently prefix-addressable by rank.

strong_lossless_q_payload.method: elide deterministic forbidden cells, temporal delta, byte shuffle, zlib level 9

mathematical_receipt.prefix_scope: a depth-k prefix recovers a_1,...,a_k and every difference Q(a_i)-Q(a_j) for 1<=i<j<=k by summing adjacent gaps

nonclaims: A top-k prefix does not preserve lower-ranked alternatives or absolute return.
Only the complete artifact reconstructs the full source table exactly.
Progressive access trades a larger full artifact for smaller task-specific prefixes.
The representation does not improve the source policy or add learned knowledge.
The result is specific to this compiled synthetic table and implemented controls.

protocol.exploratory_disclosure: The 60000-byte top-two threshold follows an exploratory in-memory stream-size probe. It is an engineering acceptance limit, not a fresh statistical discovery threshold.
